questions.question: When the priest Pashhur heard Jeremiah prophesy disaster, what did Pashhur do to Jeremiah?

answers.text: Had him beaten and put in the stocks
Asked him to pray for the whole city
Brought him before the elders to explain

questions.question: After the priest Pashhur let Jeremiah out of the stocks, what did Jeremiah do?

answers.text: Gave Pashhur a new name from the LORD
Thanked Pashhur for letting him go free

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD said He would hand Judah over to the king of which land?
Jeremiah told the priest Pashhur he would be carried off as a captive. What did the LORD say would happen to him there?

answers.text: He would die and be buried there
He would rise to serve the king
He would escape and come home
